title: Israel Indicts Settler Yinon Levi in Rare Charge Over Killing of Palestinian Activist Hathaleen
detail: Israeli prosecutors filed an indictment in a southern district court charging settler Yinon Levi with reckless manslaughter, armed trespassing, and malicious property damage over the July 2025 killing of prominent Palestinian community leader Awdah Hathaleen in the West Bank village of Umm al-Khair, South Hebron Hills. Hathaleen, a 31-year-old teacher and father of three who appeared in the Oscar-winning documentary 'No Other Land,' was killed after Levi brought an excavator into the village to level land for a new outpost, sparking a confrontation. B'Tselem said it is the first indictment of an Israeli for killing a Palestinian in the West Bank since October 7, 2023 — amid a surge of settler violence now averaging roughly 190 attacks per month, of which fewer than 3% result in conviction according to Yesh Din.

media.caption: Israeli settler Yinon Levi is charged over the July 2025 killing of Palestinian activist Awdah Hathaleen — August 6, 2026
